**Overview And Responsibilities**
 The Applied Machine Learning Group is seeking a Software Engineer to build and scale systems that power
   

  

 content understanding, metadata enrichment, and personalization across Paramount's global content
   

  

 catalog. In this role, you will work on the core infrastructure and internal tools that enable high\-
   

  

 quality metadata ingestion and curation directly impacting content discovery,
   

  

 recommendations, and user experience across Paramount's streaming portfolio.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional role at the intersection of content, data, and machine learning,
   

  

 partnering closely with ML engineers, product teams, and data stakeholders to bring metadata\-driven
   

  

 experiences to life.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be:
   

  

* Enthusiastic about spanning the full lifecycle of a content data system from ingest and


 enrichment through deployment, monitoring, and downstream delivery
   

  

* Invested in going beyond moving data to understanding it; developing domain\-level


 familiarity with the content catalog, and how data quality issues upstream affect systems
   

  

 downstream
   

  

* Committed to continuous improvement; takes ownership of feature implementation,


 plans for future maintainability
   

  

* Skilled at partnering with Product to translate evolving content strategy into concrete


 engineering decisions; asking clarifying questions and iterating toward well\-defined
   

  

 solutions under ambiguity
   

  

* Collaborative across engineering teams; working with upstream providers and


 downstream consumers to define integration contracts, and ensuring the sequencing of
   

  

 changes so that features ship cohesively
   

  

* Eager to leverage AI agents in the software development process for understanding


 code, troubleshooting, developing new features, and fixing issues
   

  

**Responsibilities Include:**
 Metadata Ingestion \& Enrichment
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain backend services that support content understanding,


 metadata modeling, and enrichment workflows
   

  

* Contribute to systems that process and manage metadata for a large\-scale, global


 content catalog
   

  

 Backend Services \& Data Modeling
   

  

* Maintain and expand the API layer and data models across two provider contexts


 (Paramount\+ and PlutoTV) as the codebase converges toward a unified multi\-tenant
   

  

 architecture
   

  

* Uphold engineering quality through test coverage, code reviews, and consistent


 application of coding standards
   

  

 Internal Tooling \& Curation
   

  

* Support editorial curation workflows that feed the personalization experience, ensuring


 curators have the tooling and data quality needed to make effective content decisions
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Strong proficiency in a Python web API and ORM framework (Django/ORM/DRF


 preferred)
   

  

* Knowledge of cloud infrastructure including managed databases, object storage, and


 container orchestration (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
   

  

* API design with backwards compatibility across multiple consumer teams
* Relational data modeling for transactional systems
* Experience building data engineering pipelines, including best practices like defensive


 coding at ingestion boundaries, instrumentation to surface anomalies early, and
   

  

 awareness of data drift so that quality issues are caught before they propagate
   

  

 downstream
   

  

**Additional Qualifications**
* Django and Django REST Framework for production backend applications
* Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, GKE
* Google Cloud Pub/Sub subscriber/publisher patterns
* Elasticsearch index management, full\-text search, mapping updates
* Experience building content metadata management systems
* Exposure to personalization, recommendation systems, or ML\-adjacent platforms
* Experience working in event\-driven architectures, designing systems around async


 pipelines
